title: Verra pipeline config
description: Where the pipeline reads and writes, how files are named, and how much bad input it tolerates.

$schema.description: Path to this format file, so editors can check the config as you type.

root.description: Folder every relative path below is resolved from, itself relative to this config file.

landing.description: Folder this system's daily raw files arrive in. Only ever read.

file_name.description: Name of one raw file. Placeholders: {prefix} (from the bronze table's source) and {date} (YYYY-MM-DD).

sources.description: The source systems the pipeline loads from, by name. Each bronze table names its system in source.system.

lake.description: Folder the layers are written to as Parquet.

warehouse.description: DuckDB file holding the query views over the lake.

table_file.description: Where one table's data for one snapshot is written, under the lake folder. Placeholders: {layer}, {table}, {date}.

manifest_file.description: Where a stage's record of a run is written, under the lake folder. Placeholders: {stage}, {date}.

current_view.description: Name of the view showing the latest snapshot of a table. Placeholder: {table}.

history_view.description: Name of the view showing every snapshot of a table. Placeholder: {table}.

max_rejected_share.description: Stop the run when more than this share of a file's lines cannot be read, e.g. 0.01 for 1%.
